# CRAFT GTM

> CRAFT GTM is a free web app and AI connector with eight planning tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting. Give it your metrics, launch date, customers or competitors, and it returns a product-market fit scorecard, a launch plan, interview guides, retention, partner or crisis playbooks, battle cards, or a CRAFT review of any GTM document.

- Web app (no sign-in): https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-gtm-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-gtm-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Claude plugins: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [PMF Scorecard](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/pmf-scorecard/) (`pmf_scorecard`): Generate a Product-Market Fit scorecard. Parses the metrics you provide (MRR, churn, NPS, CAC, LTV, retention, activation and similar) and scores each dimension against built-in benchmark ranges.
- [Launch Commander](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/launch-commander/) (`launch_commander`): Generate a context-aware launch plan. Have a date? Get a detailed timeline. Still planning? Enter 'TBD' or a quarter such as 'Q2 2027' for a flexible plan.
- [Customer Interview Kit](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/customer-interview-kit/) (`customer_interview_kit`): Generate interview guides that ADAPT based on interview type, industry, and product complexity. Includes synthesis templates.
- [Retention Playbook](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/retention-playbook/) (`retention_playbook`): Generate retention strategies. Has DISCOVERY MODE - if you don't know WHY people churn, get a churn analysis framework first.
- [Partner Architect](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/partner-architect/) (`partner_architect`): Design partner programs that ADAPT based on partner model type. Different structures for resellers vs referrals vs integrations vs affiliates.
- [Crisis Planner](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/crisis-planner/) (`crisis_planner`): Generate crisis playbooks. Know your risks? Get specific playbooks. Not sure what to plan for? The tool uses a default set of common crises for your industry (not ranked by likelihood).
- [Competitive Intel](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/competitive-intel/) (`competitive_intel`): Generate battle cards. If you know your strengths/weaknesses, get complete battle cards. If you only know competitors and win/loss stories, we'll derive your positioning.
- [CRAFT GTM Analyzer](https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/tools/craft-gtm-analyzer/) (`craft_gtm_analyzer`): Analyze a GTM document against the CRAFT framework. Parses the content, identifies gaps, scores each dimension and suggests sections to add.

## Questions and answers

### What is CRAFT GTM?

CRAFT GTM is a free web app and AI connector with eight planning tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting. Give it your metrics, launch date, customers or competitors, and it returns a product-market fit scorecard, a launch plan, interview guides, retention, partner or crisis playbooks, battle cards, or a CRAFT review of any GTM document.

### Is CRAFT GTM free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude or ChatGPT as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the CRAFT GTM code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. Nothing is stored and nothing you type is logged. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use CRAFT GTM in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it CRAFT GTM, paste https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/mcp and choose no sign-in. The Connect page covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, a business consulting firm founded in 2022 in Bengaluru. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://craft-gtm.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-gtm-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/craft-gtm-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is CRAFT GTM not ideal for?

Teams that want finished, publish-ready plans: each tool returns a structured draft, with placeholders where your inputs gave no fact. Anyone who needs live market or competitor data: the tools look nothing up; they work from what you type, and anything they add themselves is marked as an example, a suggestion or a placeholder. Teams that need saved history or shared workspaces: nothing is stored, so keep each result where you keep your work.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/craft-gtm-mcp/issues.
